name: Hot Pursuit
body:
School transmutation; Level ranger 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level

DESCRIPTION

For the spell’s duration, you can move at full speed while using the Survival skill to follow tracks without any penalties (as if you already had the Master Hunter ranger class ability).
